identityIntro: What is your name? Let's start there.
backgroundIntro: This helps us prepare the program and speak to you in your language.
preferredLanguageLabel: Which language do you want the app in?
documentationIntro: This step is optional. If you have an identity document, you can add it here. If you don't have one, choose "I don't have one". If you'd rather not give it now, skip this step.
documentReassurance: Only the Ramassà team can see this, and it is stored encrypted.
equipmentIntro: What clothing size and shoe size do you wear?
logisticsIntro: These details help us contact you and understand whether anyone depends on your care.
termsIntro: On the next screen, you can read the app’s terms and conditions.
termsPointPurposeBody: To organize training, events and kit, and to stay in touch with you.
termsPointProtectedBody: Sensitive details are encrypted and only the Ramassà team can see them.
termsPointPrivateBody: We do not share your data outside the program or use it for advertising.
termsPointControlBody: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time.
termsBody: Ramassà keeps your data to run the program's sports and community activity: training, events, kit, and staying in touch with you. Sensitive data (document, phone, address) is stored encrypted and only the Ramassà team can see it. We never share your data with anyone outside the program or use it for advertising. You can ask to see, correct or delete it at any time by talking to the team.
termsAcceptLabel: I have read and accept the terms
mediaConsentLabel: I'm happy to appear in community photos and stories (optional)
mediaConsentHint: You can change your photo and video permission at any time from your profile.
termsUpdateLoadFailed: We could not load the new terms. Here is the text you already know. Try again to accept the new ones.
termsLeaveBody: You will be signed out. You cannot enter the app until you accept the terms. Your answers will stay saved on this device. Sign in again here to continue.
errorSummary: Check the marked fields before continuing.
errorTooYoung: You need to be 16 or older. If you are younger, talk to the Ramassà team.
errorInvalidDate: Enter a valid day, month and four-digit year.
errorNieFormat: A NIE is one letter, seven digits and one letter. For example: X1234567L.
errorPhoneFormat: Write the phone with its prefix, for example +34 600 111 222.
errorPostalFormat: A postal code is five digits.
errorMunicipalityInvalid: Choose a municipality from the list.
errorDependentsRange: Tell us how many, between 1 and 15.
errorTermsRequired: To continue you have to accept the terms. Tap "I have read and accept the terms".
completionFailed: We could not save your details. Please try again.

childcareNeedLabel: Does she need childcare during training?

seasonStepIntro: Every question is optional. They help us support you better this season.
